caption:
"There are no appointments anywhere." Usually there are — just not when you looked.

Availability at UAE consulates tightens sharply before peak season and releases in irregular batches. Checking once and concluding it is impossible is the most common reason people miss trips.

What works is a complete file ready in advance and someone watching daily.
